label: Primitive Roots of Unity
subgoals: The n-th cyclotomic polynomial has the primitive n-th roots of unity as its roots.
Its degree is Euler phi of n.

label: Factoring x^n minus one
subgoals: The polynomial x to the n minus one factors into cyclotomic polynomials indexed by the divisors of n.
The degrees of those factors add up to n.

label: Extensions Generated by a Root
subgoals: A primitive root generates an extension whose degree is the order of the multiplicative group modulo n.
That order is phi of n, matching the degree of the polynomial.
